name: Khan Jehn
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
The earth speaks to me, and it says that the Magram grow weak.  Now it is time to kill their Khan!

Bring me the head of the Magram Khan, Jehn!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Khan Jehn's Head to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText: Khan Jehn was strong, but stupid. He thought his own strength was great. He did not see that earth magic is stronger. The Magram centaur will now fall without their leader, and the Gelkis will one day rule!
narrative.requestItemsText: Show me you are a friend of the Gelkis, adventurer.
